meta.title: Content Gap Audit + Research DB Foundation
meta.purpose: Do not replace good existing content. This file identifies only missing, weak, conflicting or unsafe content/data that should be researched and implemented next.
meta.important_rule: Existing verified/strong content must remain untouched unless a later phase explicitly replaces a weak or conflicting field.

do_not_touch_in_phase_1: Existing routes and canonical URL strategy
Existing authored Online MBA content unless a specific factual conflict is found
Existing source metadata that is already correct

critical_findings.issue: The 14-university master dataset is only partially verified and has large empty field groups.
critical_findings.evidence: All 14 records are marked partial_verification; most have empty admission details, scholarship arrays, and several recognition/basic-information fields.
critical_findings.action: Do not publish these empty fields as generic prose. Research and populate them from current official sources in Phase 2.

critical_findings.issue: university-course-master-content.json contains a stale/mismatched university_research universe.
critical_findings.evidence: Current university master has Amity, MUJ, VGU, LPU, DU SOL, IGNOU, NMIMS, CU, DPU, NSOU, KSOU, Subharti, BAOU and JAIN. The research object instead includes SMU, Sharda, OP Jindal, Galgotias, Parul and MAHE and omits several current universities.
critical_findings.action: Do not merge this research object into current university pages. Rebuild the research registry against the current 14-university master list.

critical_findings.issue: Only Online MBA is fully authored at the reusable course-family level.
critical_findings.evidence: course-pages/index.ts contains authored content only for online-mba; other families fall back to defaultCourseContent().
critical_findings.action: Create authored research/content files for Online MCA, BBA, BCA, B.Com, BA, MA, M.Sc and M.Com before treating those course hubs as content-complete.

critical_findings.issue: Generic fallback course content contains generic curriculum, exam and learning statements that can read as if they apply to every university.
critical_findings.action: Replace generic factual-looking statements with course-level explanatory content plus university-specific verified facts; keep universal statements clearly labelled as general guidance.

critical_findings.issue: Blog/news library is very small: only 9 long-form post-content objects exist.
critical_findings.action: Keep the existing 9; build a research-backed editorial backlog rather than mass-generating thin variants.

critical_findings.issue: The current data model has university-level scholarship arrays empty even though separate research files contain scholarship information.
critical_findings.action: Create one authoritative scholarship dataset with programme-specific overrides and source/verification metadata.

critical_findings.issue: Some current source records use secondary/aggregator sources for facts that should be official.
critical_findings.action: Use official university/regulator documents first; secondary sources may identify gaps but must not become the authority for fees, eligibility, scholarships, curriculum or exam rules.

current_course_family_gap.rule: Do not copy Online MBA prose into other course hubs. Build each course around its own search intent, curriculum logic, career pathways and university differences.

blog_article_news_gap_strategy.existing_content_action: Preserve the 9 existing long-form posts and audit factual freshness individually.
blog_article_news_gap_strategy.new_content_rule: Every new article must have a distinct user problem, primary source set, original angle, internal-link destination and update plan.
do_not_create: Keyword-swapped versions of the same article
Articles based only on competitor copy
News pages without a dated primary source

fresh_web_research_notes.finding: Current official programme hub lists 48 programs and 29 certifications and shows multiple UG/PG programme variants, so the existing programme count/content must be reconciled against the current official catalogue.

Current official MBA page separates MUJ, MAHE and SMU and provides current 2026 admission, fee, eligibility and scholarship information. Do not merge the three universities into one generic Manipal record.
Current official hub lists Online BA, BBA, BCA, MA, MBA, MBA-IF, MCA, MAJMC and M.Sc Mathematics with current duration/fee values.
Current official 2026 MBA prospectus provides exact eligibility, fee, admission and evaluation details; MBA can be completed in 24 months minimum and 48 months maximum, with semester-specific fees.

Current official MBA admission page gives 2026 eligibility and fee options and states additional processing, examination and project fees. These fee components should be represented separately rather than only as a total.

Current official pages expose programme fees, curriculum, admission steps, LMS, career services and placement-support claims. The site shows different fee figures across pages, so fee reconciliation is required before publication.

Current 2026-27 official MBA brochure contains online proctored entrance-test routes, application/test fees, dates and programme fee information. This is much stronger than using a generic university page.

Current official 2026 admission page contains July 2026 UG/PG admission notifications, steps, prospectus links and programme-specific notices. Use those documents rather than old generic admission text.

phase_1_lovable_instructions.objective: Implement only the content-data foundation. Do not rewrite visible page content yet.
steps: Create a content-research status layer for every university, course family and university-course record.
Add source metadata fields: sourceUrl, sourceType, sourceTitle, verifiedOn, verificationStatus, effectiveSession.
Create explicit statuses: verified_official, verified_regulatory, secondary_reference_only, conflicting, missing, outdated.
Rebuild the university research registry so it contains exactly the current 14 universities.
Do not import the stale university_research entries for SMU, Sharda, OP Jindal, Galgotias, Parul or MAHE into the current 14-university content system.
Mark Online MBA as authored_existing; mark the other eight course families as content_required.
Add a contentReusePolicy at every layer: university-level facts may be inherited only when relevant; long-form paragraphs must not be duplicated into university-course pages.
Do not fabricate missing fields. Render 'Not published by the university' or equivalent only after the research status confirms the official source was checked.
Do not change routes, UI, SEO URLs, comparison pages or existing good content in this phase.
Create a QA report that lists remaining missing fields after the data-status layer is implemented.

phase_order.phase_1: Content research DB + source/verification normalization (this file)
phase_order.phase_2: 14 university pages: missing factual content only
phase_order.phase_3: University × course pages: programme-specific content for the supported 155 records
phase_order.phase_5: Comparison insight layer: original analysis derived from the same verified data
phase_order.phase_6: Blog/article/news research backlog + first high-value content batch
phase_order.phase_8: Editorial QA, originality, source audit, freshness and Search Console feedback loop

publish_only_if: Important factual claims have an official/regulatory source or are explicitly labelled as general guidance.
No conflicting source is silently merged.
The page adds original analysis or decision guidance beyond a source summary.
Long-form duplication between university, course hub and university-course pages is avoided.
